<!-- Default pull request template for the tagwright org. A repository with its own
template overrides this one. -->

## What this changes

A short description of the change and the problem it solves. Link the issue it
closes if there is one.

## Behavior

- [ ] This change preserves existing behavior.
- [ ] This change changes behavior. (Say what changes below.)

If behavior changes, describe what a user of the tool will see differently.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scoped to one change, in the repository of the tool it affects.
- [ ] Tests pass, and any new behavior has a test that proves it.
- [ ] New source files carry the `SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later` header.
- [ ] Docs updated if the change affects labels, config, or behavior.
- [ ] No secret value, token, or host-identifying detail in the diff or the tests.
